children: A new CEO will be appointed at HDFC Bank “well before” October 26, when incumbent Sashidhar Jagdishan is set to retire, with the board likely to favour a candidate with “aggressive qualities” to lead the bank to the next level, a person aware of the developments told Moneycontrol.

“The board is of the view that the new CEO has to be aggressive in his approach and take everyone along as a team and ensure that the bank reaches the “top level” in the next few years,” the person said on condition of anonymity.
Asked about Jagdishan’s sudden departure, the person said there was a view that he was not “aggressive in his approach” and could not take “everybody along.
"It was the most honourable way of exit. The board appreciated his contribution,” he added.
Uncertainty emerged at HDFC Bank after the sudden resignation of then chairman Atanu Chakraborty. “ He resigned without saying what the issue was,” the person said.

“It was a divided house. There is fundamentally nothing wrong with the bank. It was a management issue,” he said, adding that the new chairman and the board took immediate measures to restore order and settled all issues, including those related to the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation (MSRDC) and additional tier-1 (AT-1) bonds.

“The ground has now been cleared, and the new CEO can start on a clean slate to steer the bank to the top-most level,” the source added. Several names have been reported to be in the running for the CEO’s position, including possibly an outsider.
Reuters has reported that HDFC Bank deputy managing editor Kaizad Bharucha could be named as the new CEO.

India's largest private lender may also opt for an external candidate, in keeping with a central bank rule requiring banks to submit up to three names for the CEO position, Reuters reported, citing people familiar with the developments. The person did not reveal any names being considered for the CEO's role. The Reserve Bank of India, the sector's regulator, clears top-level banking appointments.

title: HDFC Bank CEO to be appointed before October 26: Source
